sandbase-harness 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过 stdio MCP 将 dsh 连接到本地 SandBase Harness 运行时，用于管理代理与会话、流式执行任务、检查产物和取消工作。

posts.en:
sandbase-harness is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-96f333b4fe6efb0e70ca.html
